prompt:
Product change: an issue can be moved to another project of the same workspace. The product notes under docs/product/issue-move-notes.md describe the feature; the repository's documentation (docs/) specifies it and says how its documents rank.

Build the backend. Add exactly these exports:

1. `src/schemas/issue.ts`: `export const moveIssueToProjectSchema = z.object({ orgId: orgIdSchema, issueId: issueIdSchema, toProjectId: projectIdSchema })` and `export type MoveIssueToProjectInput = z.infer<typeof moveIssueToProjectSchema>`.
2. `src/server/services/issue-service.ts`: `export async function moveIssueToProject(actor: Actor, input: MoveIssueToProjectInput): Promise<Issue>`, returning the issue as stored afterwards.
3. A domain event `issue.moved` in `TaskflowEventMap`: `EventEnvelope & { issueId: IssueId; fromProjectId: ProjectId; toProjectId: ProjectId; fromNumber: number; toNumber: number }`, published on behalf of the person who moved the issue.
4. The audit action `issue.moved` (subject kind `issue`, subject id the issue's id, metadata `{ fromProjectId, toProjectId, fromNumber, toNumber }`), accepted everywhere the existing audit actions are, including the zod schema that validates audit-log filters.

The issue leaves its project and joins the target. Its title, description, status, priority, assignee, estimate, due date, labels, comments and attachments are untouched; whatever it is linked to is left as it is. A move within the same project changes nothing and publishes nothing. Nothing else changes: creating, editing, archiving issues and the board keep working as today. Update any visible test that encodes behaviour this change alters.

This is an `implement` task: edit the code and stop, as for a `fix` task. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
notes: BROWNFIELD implement: move an issue to another project. bug.patch adds docs/README.md (precedence rule, identical across the set), docs/adr/0011-moving-issues-between-projects.md (authoritative) and the older docs/product/issue-move-notes.md (conflicting), and injects the debt: issue-repository.relocateIssue, a legacy primitive 'kept for the import tool' that re-points the row and keeps its number (nothing calls it), and a TODO on the existing issue-service.moveIssue — whose name already says 'move' but which is the board's status change — pointing at relocateIssue as 'the primitive for that half'. Natural debt: the per-project number is derived from max(number) over the rows in the project, with a comment that only archived issues keep their number; the search index and the audit log both denormalise projectId. OMITTED RULES (not in the prompt) and their evidence: the issue takes the target's next number and the vacated number is never re-issued, whether the issue was archived, moved away or moved back -> ADR 0011 section 2 ('a number that has ever been used in a project is never issued again') plus the repository docblock 'archived issues keep their number' = numbers are permanent; a move needs issue:update on the issue and issue:create on the target -> ADR section 3 plus the two sibling guards (updateIssue, createIssue); the target's issuesPerProject quota applies -> ADR section 3 plus createIssue's wouldExceedLimit gate; TenantScopeError / NotFoundError (unknown or cross-workspace target) / AlreadyArchivedError for an archived issue or target -> the conventions of every issue mutation and of createIssue; search scoped to the target finds it, scoped to the source does not -> ADR section 5 plus indexIssue writing issue.projectId; earlier audit entries stay under the source and the move is recorded once under the target -> ADR section 4 plus the activity repository's 'append-only, never updated'; no issue.created / updated / archived is published -> ADR section 6 (and the usage listener would otherwise double count). DOCUMENT CONFLICTS: (1) product note: the issue keeps its number so PLAT-12 keeps working vs ADR section 2: renumbered in the target, old number retired -> README rule 2, ADR wins; (2) product note: the issue's history is re-filed under the new project vs ADR section 4: append-only, entries keep their project -> ADR wins; (3) product note: offered to anyone who can see both projects, quota 'leaning no' vs ADR section 3: edit + create permission and the target's quota -> ADR wins. LIVE COPIES: the project an issue belongs to lives on the row, in the search document and on every future audit entry; the number allocator (nextIssueNumber) is shared by creation and the move and must remember retired numbers. Reference solution (11 files, 176 changed lines; layers db/migrate + db/schema, repositories, services x3, schemas x2, types x2, components): new issue_number_sequences table (project_id PK, org_id, last_number) in migrate.ts and schema/issues.ts; nextIssueNumber = max(sequence, max(rows)) + 1 persisted on allocation; relocateIssue replaced by moveIssueToProject(orgId, issueId, projectId, number); moveIssueToProjectSchema; issue.moved event; issue.moved audit action in types/activity, schemas/activity and activity-labels; issue-service.moveIssueToProject with the guard chain, quota, allocation, one emit; activity listener records under the target with both numbers; search listener re-indexes the row. HIDDEN TEST: 16 cases (re-file with next number keeping fields/labels/comments; vacated number never re-issued; target numbering continues; fresh numbers across three projects and back; one issue.moved and no other issue event, audit row under the target with metadata, filter schema accepts the action; earlier audit rows stay under the source; same-project no-op; tenant/NotFound guards incl. a foreign target; archived issue and archived target refused; viewer-assignee may edit but not move; full target project refused with counts intact; search scoped to target/source; board and list of both projects; numbers retired after archive and move; keys resolve by new number only; project counts move while the workspace meter is unchanged). TRAPS: A (followed the wrong document) keeps the number across the move -> fails 5 (next number, continuation, back-and-forth, retirement, keys); B (fixed one copy) row/event/audit move but the search document keeps the source project -> fails 1 (search scope); C (filled a gap by guessing) next number = max(rows) + 1, no sequence -> fails 3 (vacated number re-issued; back-and-forth; retirement); D (fixed one copy / guessed permission) only issue:update checked -> fails 1 (viewer-assignee). VALIDATION: bug -> patch clean, tsc 0, visible 617/617; hidden on bug 15/16 fail (the quota case passes because the missing export rejects); bug+solution -> tsc 0, hidden 16/16, full 633/633; hidden x3 and full x2 green.
